title: The Point
summary: The Point is a Shinnecock Reservation marshland remembered through community use for fishing, hunting, gathering, and teaching across generations. The listing speaks from local Shinnecock landscape knowledge and does not direct readers to sensitive areas.
ancestral_territory_note: Shown in relation to Shinnecock Ancestral Land on the current ancestral territory map.
why_this_matters: For generations, Shinnecock families have utilized the rich marshlands of The Point to harvest wild resources like snow geese and huckleberries and to teach traditional hunting skills to their youth. Preserving these active communal harvesting practices demonstrates that Indigenous ecological knowledge is not a relic of the past, but a living, practical tradition that continues to sustain Native communities today.
